description: This file defines a Flutter widget called ChapterDrawer, which provides a side panel listing all chapters in a book, allowing users to select a chapter. It uses provider for state management and interacts with BookState to get chapter data and update the current selection.

classes.name: ChapterDrawer
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that renders a drawer with a list of chapters, highlighting the current chapter, and allowing the user to select a different chapter.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the ChapterDrawer, including the list of chapters with selection logic.
